max_connections_to_host.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections to a given host.

retries.description: Number of retries for failed requests.

unrestartable_receive_timeout.description: Timeout on non-restartable connections in seconds.

http_proxy.description: HTTP proxy host:port. Leave empty to disable.

ftp_proxy.description: FTP proxy host:port. Leave empty to disable.

https_proxy.description: HTTPS proxy host:port. Leave empty to disable.

socks_proxy.description: Socks proxy user@host:port. Leave empty to disable.

no_proxy_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains to bypass proxy.

http_fake_user_agent.description: Fake User-Agent string. Empty string disables faking.

http_fake_referer.description: Fake Referer string. Empty string disables faking.

max_cookie_age.description: Maximum cookie age in days. 0 for unlimited.

html_assume_codepage.description: Default codepage if not specified by server.

html_display_images.description: Display images in graphics mode (0=off, 1=on). In text mode, shows [IMG] links.

address_preference.description: Address preference (0=default, 1=prefer IPv4, 2=prefer IPv6, 3=IPv4 only, 4=IPv6 only).

bookmarks.description: List of bookmarks to store in config file. Each item has 'url' and optional 'name'. Use items schema for structure.
